item.text: The Red Hat process lookup currently finds an RPM owner by file path, then looks it up by name, version, and release in a package map keyed only by name. That can produce the warning when another architecture or version occupies the map entry. I’ll match ownership against the stored package identity and handle RPM’s known file errors explicitly.
